sources.snippet: DeepHistomorphometry OC Species-agnostic osteoclast/TRAP segmentation model for bone histomorphometry image patches. The archive contains a 2D nnU-Net v2 model with RGB input channels and tb, oc, trap+, and nucleus foreground labels.
